records.title: Status of bulk drug park in Himachal Pradesh
details:
The present status of physical and financial progress component-wise of the Himachal Pradesh 
Bulk Drug Park is as under: please see details in assurance.
(c): On the basis of representations received from the State Governments concerned, the status 
of projects, the level of fund utilisation and the anticipated completion of projects in FY2026

records.title:
LAND ACQUISITION FOR AIRPORT EXPANSION IN HIMACHAL 
PRADESH
details:
(a) to (d): On the request of the State Government of Himachal Pradesh, AAI has prepared a 
proposal for expansion of the Kangra Airport, for which additional land of 369.82 acres has 
been requested from the State Government, which is yet to be handed over to AAI.

records.title:
UPGRADATION OF AIRPORT INFRASTRUCTURE AND 
CONNECTIVITY IN HIMACHAL PRADESH
details:
On the request of the State Government of Himachal Pradesh, AAI has 
prepared a proposal for the expansion of the existing Kangra Airport, for which 369.82 acres 
of land has been requested from the State Government, which is yet to be handed over to 
AAI.

records.title: EXPANSION OF AIRPORTS
details:
(a) to (c): It was inter-alia
stated that as per the
National Civil Aviation Policy
2016, the responsibility for
providing land for airport
development, free of cost and
free from all encumbrances
lies with the respective State
Government. However, the
required land for Kangra
(Gaggal) Airport is yet to be
handed over to AAl by the
State Government.

records.title: Repair of old buildings constructed at Shimla Airport
details:
For Shimla Airport in Himachal Pradesh, the
Airports Authority of India (AAI) has allocated a budget of Rs. 1.50
crore for civil and electrical maintenance in the FY 2024-25.
Tenders have been issued and the Annual Maintenance Work has
already been awarded.
